description: Lists the network nodes configured on the NetBox system, optionally filtered (wraps NBAPI GetNetworkNodes).

ALLPARTITIONS.description: Optional. "TRUE" to list network nodes across all partitions.

NAME.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to network nodes with this name.

NODEKEY.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to this network node key.

PARTITIONKEY.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to this partition key.

UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to the node with this 16-hex-digit unique identifier.

name: get_network_nodes
